# Tabs (`tabs`)

Tabs with panels: underline, pill or boxed.

Group: Navigation. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/navigation';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createTabs` (types in `dist/web/navigation/tabs.d.ts`): `.mh-tabs` (`--underline | --pill`, `--fill`): a `role="tablist"` row of `.mh-tabs__tab` buttons (`aria-selected`, roving `tabindex`) with optional `.mh-tabs__panel`s. Left and Right arrows, Home and End move between tabs.

```ts
export function createTabs(options: TabsOptions): TabsHandle;

export interface TabsOptions {
  tabs: readonly TabItem[];
  /** Selected tab id; default the first enabled tab. */
  value?: string;
  /** Default `underline`. */
  variant?: TabsVariant;
  /** Accessible name of the tab list. */
  label?: string;
  /** Tabs share the full width. */
  fill?: boolean;
  /** `auto` (default) selects as arrow keys move; `manual` waits for Enter or Space. */
  activation?: 'auto' | 'manual';
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
}

export interface TabsHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  value(): string;
  setValue(id: string): void;
}

export interface TabItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** A count or short label after the text. */
  badge?: string | number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Panel content; tabs without panels work as a switcher (`aria-controls` is left out). */
  panel?: Child | Child[];
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createTabs } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const tabs = createTabs({
  label: 'Thermostat',
  value: location.hash.slice(1) || 'overview',
  tabs: [
    { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', panel: 'Currently 20.5°, heating to 21°.' },
    { id: 'schedule', label: 'Schedule', panel: 'Weekdays 06:30 to 22:00 at 21°.' },
    { id: 'history', label: 'History', badge: 3, panel: 'Three changes today.' },
  ],
  // Keeps the chosen tab in the address, so a reload opens the same one.
  onChange: (id) => history.replaceState(null, '', `#${id}`),
});

document.body.append(tabs.el);
```

## React API

`Tabs` (types in `dist/react/navigation.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createTabs`; controlled through `value` / `onChange`.

```ts
export function Tabs({ tabs, value, onChange, variant, label, fill, activation = 'auto' }: TabsProps);

export interface TabsProps {
  tabs: readonly TabsItem[];
  /** Controlled: the selected tab id. */
  value: string;
  onChange: (id: string) => void;
  variant?: TabsVariant;
  label?: string;
  fill?: boolean;
  activation?: 'auto' | 'manual';
}

export interface TabsItem extends Omit<TabItem, 'panel'> {
  panel?: ReactNode;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Tabs } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const TABS = [
  { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', panel: <p>Currently 20.5°, heating to 21°.</p> },
  { id: 'schedule', label: 'Schedule', panel: <p>Weekdays 06:30 to 22:00 at 21°.</p> },
  { id: 'history', label: 'History', badge: 3, panel: <p>Three changes today.</p> },
];

export function TabsExample() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('overview');
  return <Tabs label="Thermostat" tabs={TABS} value={tab} onChange={setTab} />;
}
```
